name: Returner
title: Of the Third Stone
examine: Came up the Old Road once and means to walk it lit. Oil on the hands, a stake in the pack, and a count of stones nobody asked for.
lines: Forty-one stones to the delf. I have walked them. Nine are lit tonight and I will tell you which in the morning.
The diggers are thorough. That is all I have about the diggers.
The order will not say the word south. We say it. Somebody has to carry the oil.
